name: Assemblies_generated_for_the_GPhase_benchmark_datasets
description: This dataset contains assemblies generated for the GPhase benchmark datasets intended to accompany the GPhase evaluation suite. It provides generated assembly artifacts used to evaluate assembly-generation or composition tasks in the GPhase benchmark. The resources are hosted on Hugging Face for reproducibility and benchmarking.
reputation: A niche, user-contributed dataset on Hugging Face with limited widespread adoption outside the specific GPhase user community.
